war_summary: On Day 128 of War 139, intense frontline pressure and heavy casualties continue across multiple contested sectors. Endless Shore and Oarbreaker remain the most volatile regions on the map, experiencing rapid base turnover, neutralizations, and contested states around key locations such as Brackish Point, Saltbrook Channel, Grisly Refuge, and Posterus. On the central and northern mainland fronts, Onyx, Callahans Passage, and Speaking Woods are sustaining massive casualty spikes—each seeing thousands of casualties over the past two hours with accelerating combat trends and recent base captures. Meanwhile, Clahstra remains evenly divided at 4-4 strategic base ownership following significant multi-base engagements across Transept and Bewailing Fort.
